name: AL Language XApp E
brief: Cross-app fixture E: install code and subscribers for the upgrade tag and company initialization probe.
description: Holds an install codeunit and the subscribers it observes (OnGetPerCompanyUpgradeTags, OnCompanyInitialize). It is a separate app so that its install rows stay out of the install rows of the main test app, which an install-order test lists in full. Nothing but the main test app depends on it.
